image_description: A close-up shot of a single, large soap bubble floating in an indoor environment. The bubble exhibits strong iridescence with swirling patterns of pink, green, and cyan. It reflects and distorts the background, which appears to be a room with a doorway and reddish/pink architectural elements. In the bottom left foreground, there is a blurry, purple/pink object that resembles a hand or a tool holding a wand, though it is heavily out of focus and structurally ambiguous.
